translations.title: Magnesium and Vitamin B6 Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamin B6 when your strength is low during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or during and after illness, and for muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
translations.usage: Adults take two tablets three times a day, with plenty of water during meals.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive to it, have severe kidney failure, or are a baby under 12 months old. Talk to a pharmacist if you have a heart, circulatory or kidney disorder, low blood protein, are pregnant, or are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 4 or Yellow No. 5 colouring. Do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, tetracycline antibiotics, antacids or levodopa.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency
summaryTable.Who should be careful: People with severe kidney failure or circulatory or kidney disorders
summaryTable.Why this one: A magnesium and vitamin B6 tablet

summary: Muscle cramps from magnesium deficiency and vitamin B6 supply
